title: Ready Player One
tagline: An adventure too big for the real world.
about: In 2045 a kid from the Stacks races, dances and plays his way through three of James Halliday's challenges to win the OASIS before a corporation does.
cue: Serve the curry when Art3mis asks Kira to dance at the Overlook.
faces: LOGGED IN FROM THE STACKS, COLUMBUS, OHIO, 2045
"Thanks for playing my game." James Halliday
Parzival wins the race in reverse. Hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip.
Wade was born after the corn syrup droughts. Honey butter popcorn and flaky salt.
Sixers get numbers, not names. Two smashed patties, cheese, pickles and fries.
Art3mis dances with Kira for the Jade Key. Thai green curry, beans and jasmine rice.
Wade finds Halliday's Easter egg. Chocolate egg with salted caramel and gold dust.
The Curator's coin is an extra life. Cherry cola over vanilla ice cream.
The OASIS is closed. Drink up.

    Quick PlaysCopper Key buffalo wingsParzival wins the race in reverse. Hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip.How to make it1kg chicken wings, tips off and halved1 tbsp baking powder125ml Louisiana-style hot sauce60g butter100g blue cheese, crumbled125g sour cream3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise4 celery sticks, cut in batonsPat the wings dry, toss with the baking powder and salt and lay on a rack over a tray.Bake at 220°C, turning once, until crisp and golden.Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and mayo.Melt the butter into the hot sauce and toss the wings through, then serve with celery and dip.Corn syrup drought popcornWade was born after the corn syrup droughts. Honey butter popcorn and flaky salt.How to make it150g popping corn2 tbsp vegetable oil60g butter3 tbsp honey1 tsp sea salt flakesHeat the oil in a large lidded pot, add the corn, cover and shake until the popping stops.Melt the butter with the honey until bubbling.Toss through the popcorn with the salt.Shoestring fries, one quarterMorrow's whole salary. 25 cents.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main GamesSixer number six cheeseburgerSixers get numbers, not names. Two smashed patties, cheese, pickles and fries.How to make it600g beef mince4 brioche buns8 slices of American cheese1 white onion, finely diced1/2 cup dill pickle slices4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp yellow mustard750g frozen shoestring friesBake the fries at 220°C until crisp.Mix the mayo, tomato sauce and mustard into a burger sauce.Roll the mince into 8 balls, smash thin on a hot griddle with onion and cook 2 minutes a side, cheese on top.Toast the buns and stack two patties each with pickles and sauce.Jade Key green chicken curryArt3mis dances with Kira for the Jade Key. Thai green curry, beans and jasmine rice.How to make it600g chicken thigh fillets, sliced3 tbsp green curry paste400ml tin coconut milk200g green beans, trimmed1 zucchini, sliced1 tbsp fish sauce1 tsp brown sugar1 cup Thai basil leaves1 lime300g jasmine riceFry the curry paste in a splash of the coconut milk until fragrant.Add the chicken and stir until coated, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk.Simmer with the beans and zucchini until the chicken is cooked.Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime and stir through the basil.Serve with the jasmine rice.Bonus RoundHalliday's golden Easter eggWade finds Halliday's Easter egg. Chocolate egg with salted caramel and gold dust.How to make it300g dark chocolate, chopped150g caster sugar125ml thickened cream40g butter1/2 tsp sea salt flakes1 tsp edible gold dust250g vanilla ice creamMelt two thirds of the chocolate, take off the heat and stir in the rest until glossy.Brush into 8 half-egg moulds in two coats and chill until set.Cook the sugar to deep amber, whisk in the cream, butter and salt and cool.Unmould, fill the halves with ice cream and caramel, join and brush with gold dust.RefillsExtra Life cherry cola floatThe Curator's coin is an extra life. Cherry cola over vanilla ice cream.How to make it1 L cherry cola500ml vanilla ice cream8 maraschino cherriesPut two scoops of ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses.Pour the cola slowly down the side and top with cherries.Real-world tap waterThe OASIS is closed.
